08-5.solution: Interest \(= 16800 - 15000 = 1800\) in \(2\) years. Simple interest does not depend on how often it is calculated: \(R = \frac{1800 \times 100}{15000 \times 2} = 6\%\).

08-15.solution: Interest \(= 7080 - 6000 = 1080\) in \(3\) years, so \(R = \frac{1080 \times 100}{6000 \times 3} = 6\%\) a year, which is \(\frac{6}{4} = 1.5\%\) a quarter.
